subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this PR implement the canonical server-owned pending-to-effecting request state transition now, rather than relying on a non-atomic AbortSignal check immediately before dispatch?
rationale: Only maintainers can confirm the permanent Gateway security contract and whether a negotiated request-cancellation capability is required; the current check-and-dispatch sequence does not provide the atomic guarantee requested by the linked security issue.

options.title: Require atomic request state
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until cancellation and dispatch atomically compete through server-owned pending/effecting/completed state, with race proof.

options.title: Accept partial disconnect hardening
options.body: Land the narrower connection-close mitigation without closing the canonical issue and track the atomic protocol repair separately.

recommendation.title: Require atomic request state
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until cancellation and dispatch atomically compete through server-owned pending/effecting/completed state, with race proof.
